WITH mix_counts AS (
  SELECT
    tr.ordertypedist,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS transaction_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr
    ON tr.transreg = ab.translink
  GROUP BY tr.ordertypedist
), mix_shares AS (
  SELECT
    ordertypedist,
    transaction_count,
    transaction_count::numeric / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM mix_counts
), scored AS (
  SELECT
    ordertypedist,
    transaction_count,
    share,
    AVG(share) OVER () AS baseline_share
  FROM mix_shares
)
SELECT
  ordertypedist,
  transaction_count,
  share,
  share - baseline_share AS above_baseline_share
FROM scored
WHERE share > baseline_share;
